name: sfx-ui-basic
notes: Sound effects with Stable Audio 3 Small-SFX (Community Licence + Gemma terms). 8 steps, cfg 1, lcm/simple, as tested in 8b-4. Receiver v0.7 clean-up (SFX1-SFX5): master FLAC as generated (metadata stripped) + OGG/Opus 64k mono, trailing silence trimmed, peak -3 dB. From v1.1 (receiver v0.8, D1): silence before the sound is also trimmed, keeping 10 ms. Prompt rules (SFX7): kind of sound + source + material + space ('dry, close-up') + 'Length: N seconds'; no reliance on fine details; make 3 versions with different seeds. Seconds (SFX6): ~2 for UI sounds, 3-4 for longer effects. Apps using these sounds show 'Powered by Stability AI'.
